system.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can forgo one of your attacks and spend 1 Superiority Die to mix in a jutsu’s casting. When you do so, cast one jutsu of C-Rank or lower that doesn’t make more than a single attack casting it. After its casting, you may finish making attacks with your attack action. If you would use this maneuver more than once on the same turn, increase the Superiority Die cost by +1 for each use beyond the first. This cost increase resets at the end of your current turn.
